## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions; `list_deployments` showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created INC-0001 ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback. (The first create call timed out, but the incident was actually created; I confirmed it via `list_incidents`.)
3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east completed before an orchestrator error halted the rollout). I retried the rollback, which then completed across all regions.

**Final state:** checkout-api is on **v2.3.0** in all three regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.002. Incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up.
